name: Seafrigo Investissements
note: SAS holding company (RCS Le Havre 909 922 965) that chairs the Seafrigo group companies; its president is Eric Barbe, who founded Seafrigo in Le Havre in 1979. Supervisory-board members include Credit Mutuel Equity and BNP Paribas Developpement. No state or state-fund owner is named.
